# Dreamstudio

DreamStudio is Stability AI's user interface for generative AI, allowing users to create and edit generated images.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dreamstudio/.

## Actions

- **DreamStudio User Balance** (read-only): Retrieve the user's balance information, including available credits and usage.
- **List Engines** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all engines available to your organization or user.
- **User Account** (read-only): Retrieve user account details, including id, email, credits, and profile.
- **Generate Image from Image**: Generate a new image from an initial image and text prompts.
